sources.snippet: README.md Finetune Qwen3.5 with Axolotl Qwen3.5 is a hybrid architecture model series combining Gated DeltaNet linear attention with standard Transformer attention. All Qwen3.5 models are early-fusion vision-language models: dense variants use Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration and MoE variants use Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration.
